points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Original case/report validator passes structurally, but Re200 success fraction is falsely defined and global-mesh replication metadata is false.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Explicit eight-case and report validator passed; structural acceptance does not assess true inner target, mesh memory or force plausibility.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Seven steady outputs stop before second-order activation. Re200 reaches t≈300 but claims strict inner success with relaxed/exhausted steps and yields unstable forces.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Original Cd=0.06059 M0.15 inviscid, 0.62044 M0.15 laminar, 3.157 M2 laminar, 6.140 Re20; Re200 late Cd spans −41.09 to 38.57. These prevent treating results as broadly credible.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Compiled immutable report includes steady histories/contours and Re200 full history/wake; Re200 lacks numeric shedding statistic and required readable late lift/drag analysis.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report discloses generic delayed spatial activation but not that all final steady cases are first order; falsely claims strict Re200 inner convergence and denies full mesh retention. Some force anomalies are discussed.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Report figures and manifest map canonical case files; Re200 canonical and re200_final force histories are byte-identical. Incorrect convergence and mesh statements limit reliable traceability.

disqualification_flags.flag: Figure files misnamed (e.g., Mach image that actually plots pressure)
Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
Placeholder, synthetic, or intentionally partial result files in scored case dirs
metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
Debug outputs presented as final case results
